name: staship-tv
description: Custom live channels for Jellyfin, Stashy, Plex and Emby

scripts.sync: test -n "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" || (echo 'Error: STASH_PLUGIN_DIR not set' && exit 1) && npm run build && rm -rf "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" && mkdir -p "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" && cp tvguide.js tvguide.css tvguide-server.js TVGuide.yml README.md IPTV.md NATIVE-APPS.md PLEX-EMBY.md THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt stashiptv.service "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR/"
